location_exception_reason: Mobile toilets are manufactured products with nationwide distribution and deployment; location in the title (e.g., 'Delhi-made', 'Pune portable toilet') does not alter the product's functional specification or buyer decision criteria. Buyers select by material, capacity, and features, not origin.
biz_exception_reason: Business-type words ('Manufacturer', 'Supplier', 'Dealer', 'Rental Service') are redundant in mobile toilet titles; IndiaMART's seller-type filter already exposes this information independently. Removing 'Manufacturer' from 'FRP Portable Toilet Manufacturer' leaves a complete, accurate product title. The business relationship is not the product itself.
